Trainee Registration update · 1 October 2026

This user update supersedes baseline registration behavior. New trainees can use a batch link without an existing assignment. Each registration remains pending trainer approval. Unique ID lookup is independent of name entry and works when registration is closed.

OTP 123456 is simulation; name mandatory only for synthetic demo.

Journey: Trainer/Admin selects batch → enables open registration → copies link; trainee opens exact link → enters synthetic name and mobile/email → requests simulated OTP → verifies and registers → sees generated Unique ID. Alternative: Trainer/Admin selects batch → uploads XLSX → reviews row errors → saves valid workbook. Assigned trainer reviews/approves all entries before final closure; separate completion criteria still apply. Invalid links, disabled registration, full capacity and out-of-window dates show explicit messages; input errors preserve typed values.

Public link and OTP are local review demonstrations. Shared browser storage is required to access the same records. Browser checks are not production security. Backend must authorize bulk upload and trainer approval, bind OTP to verified contact identity, and enforce batch uniqueness/capacity in database transactions.
